newsitem.title: UK: UK National Savings meet government funding target.
newsitem.headline: UK National Savings meet government funding target.

text.p: Gross sales of British National savings schemes totalled 1,010 million stg in January and met their target contribution to the government's coffers in the process, the Department for National Savings said on Saturday.

Repayments of 918 million stg and accrued interest of 179 million brought the net contribution to government financing to 271 million stg in January and 4.5 billion pounds in the first 10 months of the financial year.
"With sales for the month buoyant at over one billion, we have now passed the 4.5 billion pounds net funding assumption for 1996-97," chief executive Peter Bareau said.
The highest net contributions were from Pensioners Bonds at 130 million pounds, Premium Bonds at the same amount and the Investment Account at 56 million stg.
"National Savings has delivered another favourable result in January, despite continuing heavy maturities of Savings Certificates," Bareau said.
